# LLMS.txt Launch Kit

> LLMS.txt Launch Kit is a local-first generator, validator, and example workflow for publishing clean llms.txt files.

Use these links to understand the free sample repo, CLI, examples, and release notes.

## Project

- [README](https://github.com/758302-tech/llms-txt-launch-kit/blob/main/README.md): Quick start, purpose, included files, and publishing notes.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/758302-tech/llms-txt-launch-kit): Public free sample repository for the launch kit.
- [GitHub Pages](https://758302-tech.github.io/llms-txt-launch-kit/): Lightweight public product page for the free sample.
- [Full Pack](https://boltonmejia.gumroad.com/l/llms-txt-launch-kit): Paid Gumroad listing with editable templates, checklists, prompts, GitHub Actions, and an llms-full.txt pattern.

## Tools

- [CLI](https://github.com/758302-tech/llms-txt-launch-kit/blob/main/tools/llms_kit.py): Dependency-free Python generator and validator.
- [Example URL List](https://github.com/758302-tech/llms-txt-launch-kit/blob/main/examples/url-list.txt): Pipe-delimited URL list used to generate a sample llms.txt.
- [Example Output](https://github.com/758302-tech/llms-txt-launch-kit/blob/main/examples/free-saas-llms.txt): Spec-shaped SaaS/docs llms.txt example.

## Automation

- [Validation Workflow](https://github.com/758302-tech/llms-txt-launch-kit/blob/main/.github/workflows/validate-example.yml): GitHub Actions workflow that validates the example llms.txt file.
